correctness.rationale: For 0<λ<1, same-side quadrants are invariant fixed-point basins; mixed quadrant x<1/2<y has pre-flip x_k=1−λ^k(1−x0), y_k=λ^k y0. Their first half-threshold crossing times agree exactly on the basin of the alternating prime two-cycle; simultaneous flipping enters an alternating invariant strip, with contraction λ² for the two-step return. For uniform initial coordinates, the two crossing clocks are independent with bin widths ℓ_j=(1−λ)/(2λ^j), final ℓ_K=1−1/(2λ^{K−1}), K=ceil(log(1/2)/logλ), so A=2Σℓ_j², other two basin measures (1−A)/2. Differentiation of bins on both sides of λ_m=2^(−1/m), m≥2, gives positive left and negative right derivatives, with maximum 3(1−λ_m)/(2(1+λ_m)); asymptotically A=3(1−λ)/4+O((1−λ)²) as λ↑1. Checked rational-bin algebra and exact λ=2/3 A=1/4; independently compared one-sided derivative signs m=2..13 and numerical weak-contraction ratios 0.753141,0.750056,0.750016 for decreasing deficits. Only algebra/finite parameters were computed; proof covers infinite cusps.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not establish the universal theorem without the analytical/chain argument given; code proof obligations were reconstructed separately.
